item: 1. Germany: Lichtenau-Asseln — which MaStR groups belong to GEM's Paderborn, Asselner and Hakenberg, and double counting
farm: Paderborn wind farm / Asselner wind farm / Hakenberg wind farm
proposal:
# (a) tools/build_mastr.py MANUAL — add two entries
    'Paderborn wind farm': (['Lichtenau', 'Windpark Asseln', 'AWP', 'Windpark Lichtenau - Hakenberg', 'Windpark Lichtenau-Hakenberg',
                             'Hakenberg Driburger Strasse', '41032', 'Windpark Lichtenau'],
                            # 1993–98 年的 Windpark Asseln（62 部、36 MW，含 1993–95 年 Hakenberg 的 Nordex N27、Tacke、NEG Micon）原址：MaStR 裡含 1993–98 年機組的各群，共 38.37 MW（原機仍運轉 40 部、20.77 MW，其餘是原址補建與汰換）
                            'https://web.archive.org/web/20240126012246/https://www.asseln.de/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=4&Itemid=21'),
    'Asselner wind farm': (['Asselner Windpark'],   # Asselner Windkraft 2015 年 12 月的 7 部 E-92＋1 部 E-115（19.45 MW）；MaStR 同名群另含 2018 年的 E-115（AWK 10）與 E-82（Heggewind），共 24.75 MW
                           'https://www.thewindpower.net/windfarm_en_12163_asselner-windpark.php'),

# (b) tools/farm_cleanup.py RULES (DEU) — two fixes
    fix('DEU', 'Paderborn wind farm', G,
        '即 Lichtenau-Asseln 的 Windpark Asseln（GEM 的別名 Asseln wind farm）；GEM 的概略點位在風場北方約 2.7 km，靠近 2015–17 年另外的 WP LA、WP Lichtenau 機組，改用德文維基的座標（北緯 51°38′24″、東經 8°54′35″）',
        'This is the Windpark Asseln at Lichtenau-Asseln (GEM’s other name: Asseln wind farm); GEM’s approximate point is about 2.7 km north of the park, next to the separate WP LA and WP Lichtenau turbines of 2015–17, so the German Wikipedia coordinates are used (51°38′24″ N, 8°54′35″ E)',
        'https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windpark_Lichtenau-Asseln', lat=51.64, lon=8.91),
    fix('DEU', 'Asselner wind farm', G,
        'Asselner Windpark：2015 年 12 月 7 部 Enercon E-92＋1 部 E-115（19.45 MW，The Wind Power）；MaStR 的同名群另有 2018 年 2 部（E-115 3 MW、E-82 2.3 MW），共 24.75 MW',
        'Asselner Windpark: 7 Enercon E-92 and one E-115 of December 2015 (19.45 MW, The Wind Power); MaStR’s group of that name adds 2 units of 2018 (an E-115 of 3 MW and an E-82 of 2.3 MW), 24.75 MW in all',
        'https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStR/Datendownload', mw=24.75, ph=[[2015, 19.45], [2018, 5.3]]),

# (c) tools/farm_cleanup.py NOT_DUP — delete the entry ('DEU', 'Windpark Asseln'): after (a) that MaStR park is absorbed into Paderborn and no longer exists.
note_zh: MaStR（本機匯出檔）在 Asseln 周圍 2.5 km 內有 133.77 MW 運轉中。四筆紀錄與群的對應：(1) GEM「Paderborn」（36 MW、1998，別名 Asseln wind farm，出處是 asseln.de）＝1993–98 年的老 Windpark Asseln：asseln.de 的機型表 62 部裡包括 2 部 N27/150、2 部 N27/250、2 部 Tacke TW 600、NEG Micon M 700 等，也就是 MaStR 裡 1993–95 年 Hoppe 1–6、Hakenberg500 與 1996 年 NM 250（AWP）這些 Hakenberg 的老機，所以老風場包括 Hakenberg 那一角。MaStR 現存 1993–98 年的機組 40 部、20.77 MW 仍運轉（另 8 部、3.9 MW 在 2021–26 年停役，其餘約 14 部在登錄前已拆；德文維基舊版說 2015 年汰換 12 部，其中 1 部是 2007 年補建的 E-48），分散在 8 個名稱群：Lichtenau、Windpark Asseln、AWP、Windpark Lichtenau - Hakenberg、Windpark Lichtenau-Hakenberg、Hakenberg Driburger Strasse、41032、Windpark Lichtenau；這 8 群合計 38.37 MW（含原址的補建與汰換機組），接近 36 MW。(2) GEM「Asselner」（19.5 MW、2015、Asselner Windkraft）＝The Wind Power 的 Asselner Windpark（7 部 E92/2350＋1 部 E115/3000，19.45 MW）＝MaStR「Asselner Windpark」群 2015 年 12 月的 8 部；同群另有 2018 年 AWK 10（E-115）與 Heggewind（E-82），共 24.75 MW。(3) GEM「Hakenberg」（15 MW、2016、Stadtwerke Lichtenau，出處 MaStR）＝「Windpark Hakenberg」5 部 E-115，現在已正確配對，不需改。(4) MaStR 新增的「WP Asseln」（10.75 MW：2020 年 E-92、2024–25 年 2 部 E-138，取代 7 部 E-40 與 1 部 E-53）是新機組，保留。現況配錯：自動配對把 Paderborn 配到北方 1–2 km 的 WP LA、WP Lichtenau（2015–17）與 41032（28.85 MW），Asselner 配到老風場的 Lichtenau 群與 Hakenberg 老機（21.27 MW），真正的 Asselner Windpark 群（24.75 MW）因容量超出 ±20% 被擱置；MaStR 新增的 Windpark Asseln（10.75，含 4.0 MW 老機）與 AWP（5.65，含 1.0 MW 老機）與 Paderborn 的 36 MW 重複計算約 5 MW，而 WP LA（12.3）與 WP Lichtenau（16.05）被 Paderborn 預扣、沒有出現。以沙盒複本跑 build_mastr.py（輸出寫到暫存區）驗證 (a) 的結果：turbines_de 的 Paderborn 改為上述 8 群 38.37 MW、Asselner 改為 24.75 MW、Hakenberg 不變；MaStR 新增層刪掉 Windpark Asseln（−10.75）與 AWP（−5.65），新增 WP Lichtenau（+16.05）、WP LA（+12.3），另因 MANUAL 釋出與「Paderborn」同字的群，新增 Paderborn-Benhausen（+6.9，2017 年 2 部 Vestas V126，Benhausen，旁邊 GEM 的 Dahl 已配到別的群）與 Windpark Paderborn-Sande（+2.3，2014 年 1 部 E-82）：新增層淨增 21.15 MW（24,354→24,375 MW），陸域檢查 66,776／71,102 MW 通過。(b) 的 Asselner 修正再加 5.25 MW。此區合計：現在 112.9 MW（紀錄 70.5＋新增 42.4），改後 130.1 MW，對 MaStR 133.77 MW（差額是 1 MW 以下不加的單機與 Paderborn 36／38.37 的差）。改後沒有紀錄重複計算另一筆。
note_en: MaStR (local extract) has 133.77 MW operating within 2.5 km of Asseln. Records and groups: (1) GEM's 'Paderborn' (36 MW, 1998, other name Asseln wind farm, sourced to asseln.de) is the old 1993–98 Windpark Asseln: asseln.de's type table of 62 turbines includes 2 N27/150, 2 N27/250, 2 Tacke TW 600, a NEG Micon M 700 and so on, i.e. MaStR's 1993–95 Hoppe 1–6 and Hakenberg500 and the 1996 NM 250 (AWP) at Hakenberg, so the old park includes the Hakenberg corner. MaStR still has 40 operating units of 1993–98 (20.77 MW; 8 more, 3.9 MW, were shut in 2021–26 and about 14 were removed before registration; an earlier German Wikipedia version says 12 were replaced in 2015, one of them an E-48 added in 2007), spread over 8 name groups: Lichtenau, Windpark Asseln, AWP, Windpark Lichtenau - Hakenberg, Windpark Lichtenau-Hakenberg, Hakenberg Driburger Strasse, 41032 and Windpark Lichtenau; together they hold 38.37 MW (with infill and replacement units on the same ground), close to the 36 MW. (2) GEM's 'Asselner' (19.5 MW, 2015, Asselner Windkraft) is The Wind Power's Asselner Windpark (7 E92/2350 + 1 E115/3000, 19.45 MW) = the 8 December-2015 units of MaStR's 'Asselner Windpark' group; the group also holds AWK 10 (E-115) and Heggewind (E-82) of 2018, 24.75 MW in all. (3) GEM's 'Hakenberg' (15 MW, 2016, Stadtwerke Lichtenau, sourced to MaStR) = 'Windpark Hakenberg', 5 E-115, already matched correctly. (4) The MaStR-added 'WP Asseln' (10.75 MW: an E-92 of 2020 and 2 E-138 of 2024–25 that replaced 7 E-40 and an E-53) is new turbines and stays. Current mismatch: the automatic matching gives Paderborn WP LA, WP Lichtenau (2015–17) and 41032 1–2 km to the north (28.85 MW) and gives Asselner the old park's Lichtenau group and the old Hakenberg units (21.27 MW), while the real Asselner Windpark group (24.75 MW) is left aside for being outside ±20%; the MaStR-added Windpark Asseln (10.75, 4.0 MW of it old units) and AWP (5.65, 1.0 MW old) double-count about 5 MW of Paderborn's 36 MW, and WP LA (12.3) and WP Lichtenau (16.05) are held back by Paderborn and never shown. A sandboxed copy of build_mastr.py (outputs to scratch) confirms (a): Paderborn's turbines become those 8 groups (38.37 MW), Asselner's become 24.75 MW, Hakenberg is unchanged; the MaStR-added layer loses Windpark Asseln (−10.75) and AWP (−5.65) and gains WP Lichtenau (+16.05) and WP LA (+12.3), plus, because the MANUAL releases groups sharing the word 'Paderborn', Paderborn-Benhausen (+6.9, 2 Vestas V126 of 2017 at Benhausen; GEM's Dahl next to it is matched to other groups) and Windpark Paderborn-Sande (+2.3, an E-82 of 2014): net +21.15 MW added (24,354 → 24,375 MW), onshore check 66,776 / 71,102 MW passes. The Asselner fix in (b) adds 5.25 MW. Cluster total: now 112.9 MW (records 70.5 + added 42.4), after the change 130.1 MW against MaStR's 133.77 MW (the gap is sub-1 MW single units that are never added and Paderborn's 36 vs 38.37). After the change no record double-counts another.
why: Group membership, dates, models and operator numbers are from the local MaStR EinheitenWind extract (not quotable; the site cites the Datendownload page as for Süderauerdorf). The asseln.de type table ties the 1993–95 Hakenberg units to the 62-turbine park; The Wind Power ties GEM's 19.5 MW to the 8 December-2015 Asselner Windpark units; the 2015 and 2024 repowering counts come from the dewiki.de mirror of an earlier German Wikipedia version (the current article dropped that paragraph). MANUAL assigns whole MaStR groups, and Windpark Asseln, AWP and Windpark Lichtenau - Hakenberg mix 1993–98 units with later replacements, so they cannot be split; putting them with Paderborn keeps the area total closest to MaStR. Not proposed: cutting Paderborn's 36 MW (the as-built figure; its footprint groups now hold 38.37 MW). The Paderborn fix in (b) is optional (MANUAL works within 10 km either way); renaming it to 'Asseln wind farm' would also need the MANUAL key renamed. Sources tried without quotable result: the Wind Power operator page for Asselner Windkraft (empty), UVP-Verbund project description PDF (HTTP 429), Wikipedia API (429).

item: 2. Fujian: Zhangpu Liu'ao area E (and D) — position and status
farm: Fujian Zhangpu Liu'Ao Offshore wind farm · E / · D
proposal:
# tools/farm_cleanup.py — edit the existing area D rule (fix('CHN', "Fujian Zhangpu Liu'Ao Offshore wind farm · D", G, ...)): replace the last sentence of zh/en and the url, add lat/lon/approx
    fix('CHN', "Fujian Zhangpu Liu'Ao Offshore wind farm · D", G,
        '六鰲 D 區（402 MW）是海峽發電已核准的項目（2018 年券商報告已列），但查無開工紀錄：二期在 2023 年開工時與 2024 年都還被稱為閩南首個海上風電項目，2024-06 海峽發電的項目清單只列「負責控股建設漳浦六鰲二期」'
        '與「籌建平海灣 DE 區」，沒有 D 區；改為前期開發（GEM 寫興建中）。點位改到漳州海事局 2026-08 通告的「D 區 4 號測風塔」（北緯 23°49′25.57″、東經 118°01′29.45″，2026-09 拆除），仍是概略位置；GEM 原點位貼近六鰲海岸',
        "Liu'ao area D (402 MW) is an approved Straits Power project (already listed in a 2018 broker report) with no record of construction: phase 2 was still called the first offshore wind project in southern Fujian when it started in 2023 and in 2024, and Straits Power's project list of June 2024 names only Zhangpu Liu'ao phase 2 (under construction) and Pinghai Bay DE (in preparation), not area D; moved to pre-construction (GEM says construction). "
        "The point moves to the 'area D met mast No. 4' of a Zhangzhou MSA notice of Aug 2026 (23°49′25.57″ N, 118°01′29.45″ E, removed in Sept 2026), still approximate; GEM's point hugged the Liu'ao coast",
        'https://www.msa.gov.cn/msacncms_wap/pages/content.jhtml?articleId=5747a71192184f58bf7a009e7d857649', st=2, note=True, zhname='福建漳浦六鰲海上風電場D區', lat=23.824, lon=118.025, approx=True),
# (the existing Feb-2024 broker-report url 'https://epaper.cs.com.cn/zgzqb/images/2024-06/08/B075/zqB07508.pdf' can stay instead if the main session prefers; the MSA url backs only the new sentence)
# Area E: no change (existing rule st=2 stays; position unverified).
note_zh: E 區：福建海事局航行通告（行動版 API，2020-01 至 2026-10 共 3,695 則）與航行警告（921 則）都沒有任何六鰲 E 區的通告；以「六鰲 E 區」查漳州、福建自然資源、生態環境、發改委與省海上風電規劃都找不到用海、環評或核准文件。GEM 的 E 區點位（北緯 22.7333、東經 118.0333，標 exact）在台灣淺灘上，仍無法核對；GEM 同頁的 F-1 在北緯 23.8897、東經 118.0933，D 區的測風塔在北緯 23.82、東經 118.02，北緯 23.73 的打字錯誤是可能的，但沒有出處，不改。狀態維持現有規則（前期開發）。D 區（附帶）：漳州海事局 2026-08-20 通告（閩航通〔2026〕0531 號）的「漳浦六鰲海上風電場 D 區 4 號測風塔拆除項目」以測風塔中心 23°49′25.57″N／118°01′29.45″E 為圓心劃安全區，2026-09-24 拆除完工（0609 號）。這是第一個有官方座標、明確屬於 D 區的設施：在六鰲二期風機區（離岸 30.3–37 km）西南約 19 km、GEM 的 D 區點位（貼近六鰲海岸）東南約 22 km。建議把 D 區點位移到測風塔位置並保留「概略位置」（測風塔不是風場範圍的中心）。測風塔在 2026 年 9 月拆除，可能表示測風已完成，也可能表示計畫有變；查無開工或停止的紀錄，狀態維持前期開發。
note_en: Area E: the Fujian MSA navigation notices on the mobile API (3,695 notices, Jan 2020 – Oct 2026) and navigation warnings (921) contain nothing on Liu'ao area E; searches for 'Liu'ao E area' at the Zhangzhou and Fujian natural-resources, ecology and development bodies and in the provincial offshore wind plan found no sea-use, EIA or approval document. GEM's E point (22.7333 N, 118.0333 E, marked exact) lies on the Taiwan Bank and still cannot be checked; GEM's F-1 on the same page is at 23.8897 N, 118.0933 E and the area D met mast is at 23.82 N, 118.02 E, so a slip for 23.73 N is possible, but nothing says so and the point is not moved. Status stays as in the existing rule (pre-construction). Area D (found on the way): Zhangzhou MSA notice of 20 Aug 2026 (Min Hang Tong [2026] 0531) on the 'Zhangpu Liu'ao offshore wind farm area D met mast No. 4 removal' sets a safety zone around the mast centre at 23°49′25.57″ N, 118°01′29.45″ E; the removal was completed on 24 Sept 2026 (notice 0609). This is the first facility with official coordinates that belongs explicitly to area D: about 19 km south-west of the Liu'ao phase 2 turbine area (30.3–37 km off the coast) and about 22 km south-east of GEM's area D point, which hugs the Liu'ao coast. Proposed: move area D to the met mast and keep it flagged approximate (a met mast is not the centre of the site). The mast was removed in September 2026, which may mean the measurement campaign ended or that plans changed; with no record of construction or cancellation the status stays pre-construction.
why: Area E: no citable position or status change; MSA notice lists (navigation notices channel 3d725583ac134dfcb74aa8c47b14a164 and warnings channel 7b08405760384570a0fb44e9204c4b1d, both complete back to 2020) have no E-area entry; web searches for E-area sea-use/EIA/approval found only GEM, GlobalData and 4C (not citable). The area D change is a 'write'-grade proposal resting on the MSA notice (OK), kept approximate because the boundary is still unknown.
